selection: Keep existing call_builtin, OpKind/Builtin tags and image hash inputs unchanged. Force-inline existing executeBuiltin for constant minus_rot only, preserving all common hooks.
basis: Linux baseline-minus-rot measured builtinInLoop+executeBuiltin+rotate each1 per iteration. Native call removal not yet verified for new prototype.
compatibility_reason: Image encoder normalizes primitive ops, but layoutSignature hashes every OpKind enum name/value. Do not add new primitive tag.
error_contract: Existing executeBuiltin executes result first, checks pending output error, then propagates result, then coverage. Do not manually invert error priority.
